class.name: SkyMaterialND
class.brief_description: Base class for ND sky materials.
class.description: A resource used by [WorldEnvironmentND] to provide the background of an ND scene. [SkyMaterialND] is intended as an abstract base; use [PlainSkyMaterialND] or a custom subclass.

members.member: The sky's overall brightness multiplier. Higher values result in a brighter background.
